features: Spawn towers in any Tower defense games but not all tower defense username (Tanner_v44)

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
if not player then
	warn("TowerHub must run as a LocalScript.")
	return
end

local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 15)

if not playerGui then
	warn("TowerHub: PlayerGui was not found.")
	return
end

print("TowerHub: script started")

local oldGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("TowerHub")

if oldGui then
	oldGui:Destroy()
end

--==================================================
-- FIND UNIT / TOWER FOLDERS
--==================================================

local folderNames = {
	tower = true,
	towers = true,

	unit = true,
	units = true,

	troop = true,
	troops = true,

	character = true,
	characters = true,

	npc = true,
	npcs = true,

	unitsfolder = true,
	towerfolder = true,
}

local function isUnitTowerFolder(object)
	return object:IsA("Folder")
		and folderNames[object.Name:lower()] == true
end

local function getAllUnitsAndTowers()
	local objects = {}
	local seen = {}

	for _, folder in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
		if isUnitTowerFolder(folder) then
			for _, object in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
				if not seen[object] then
					seen[object] = true
					table.insert(objects, object)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	table.sort(objects, function(a, b)
		return a.Name:lower() < b.Name:lower()
	end)

	return objects
end

local uiScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
uiScale.Scale = 1
uiScale.Parent = main

local function updateScale()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

	if not camera then
		return
	end

	local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
	local width = viewport.X
	local height = viewport.Y

	local scaleX = (width - 20) / 560
	local scaleY = (height - 20) / 400
	local screenScale = math.min(scaleX, scaleY)

	if width <= 390 then
		uiScale.Scale = math.min(screenScale, 0.82)
	elseif width <= 600 then
		uiScale.Scale = math.min(screenScale, 0.90)
	else
		uiScale.Scale = math.min(screenScale, 1)
	end

	if uiScale.Scale <= 0 then
		uiScale.Scale = 0.5
	end
end

local function connectCamera()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

	if not camera then
		return
	end

	camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(updateScale)
	updateScale()
end

local aliases = {
	Damage = {
		"Damage",
		"AttackDamage",
		"Attack",
		"DMG"
	},

		"DamagePerSec"

local function readValueObject(object)
	if object:IsA("NumberValue")
		or object:IsA("IntValue")
		or object:IsA("StringValue")
		or object:IsA("BoolValue") then

		return object.Value
	end

	return nil
end

local function findStatInObject(object, statName)
	if not object then
		return nil
	end

	local attribute = object:GetAttribute(statName)

	if attribute ~= nil then
		return attribute
	end

	local direct = object:FindFirstChild(statName)

	if direct then
		local value = readValueObject(direct)

		if value ~= nil then
			return value
		end
	end

	for _, alias in ipairs(aliases[statName] or {}) do
		local child = object:FindFirstChild(alias)

		if child then
			local value = readValueObject(child)

			if value ~= nil then
				return value
			end
		end

		local attr = object:GetAttribute(alias)

		if attr ~= nil then
			return attr
		end
	end

	for _, descendant in ipairs(object:GetDescendants()) do
		local attr = descendant:GetAttribute(statName)

		if attr ~= nil then
			return attr
		end

		local value = readValueObject(descendant)

		if value ~= nil then
			if descendant.Name:lower() == statName:lower() then
				return value
			end

			for _, alias in ipairs(aliases[statName] or {}) do
				if descendant.Name:lower() == alias:lower() then
					return value
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return nil
end

local function findStatInModule(moduleScript, statName)
	if not moduleScript or not moduleScript:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		return nil
	end

	local success, data = pcall(require, moduleScript)

	if not success or type(data) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end

	if data[statName] ~= nil then
		return data[statName]
	end

	for _, alias in ipairs(aliases[statName] or {}) do
		if data[alias] ~= nil then
			return data[alias]
		end
	end

	for key, value in pairs(data) do
		if type(key) == "string" then
			if key:lower() == statName:lower() then
				return value
			end

			for _, alias in ipairs(aliases[statName] or {}) do
				if key:lower() == alias:lower() then
					return value
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return nil
end

local function findStat(unit, statName)
	local result = findStatInObject(unit, statName)

	if result ~= nil then
		return result
	end

	for _, configName in ipairs({
		"Config",
		"Configuration",
		"Stats",
		"Data",
		"TowerData",
		"UnitData"
	}) do

		local config = unit:FindFirstChild(configName)

		if config then
			result = findStatInObject(config, statName)

			if result ~= nil then
				return result
			end
		end
	end

	for _, object in ipairs(unit:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			result = findStatInModule(object, statName)

			if result ~= nil then
				return result
			end
		end
	end

	return "N/A"
end

local selectedUnit = nil

local towerButtons = {}

local function animateStat(name, value)
	local data = statCards[name]

	if not data then
		return
	end

	data.Value.Text = tostring(value)
	data.Value.TextTransparency = 1

	TweenService:Create(
		data.Value,
		TweenInfo.new(
			0.2,
			Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,
			Enum.EasingDirection.Out
		),
		{
			TextTransparency = 0
		}
	):Play()
end

local function calculateDPS(unit)
	local directDPS = findStat(unit, "DPS")

	if directDPS ~= "N/A" then
		return directDPS
	end

	local damage = findStat(unit, "Damage")
	local cooldown = findStat(unit, "Cooldown")

	if type(damage) == "number"
		and type(cooldown) == "number"
		and cooldown > 0 then

		return math.round((damage / cooldown) * 100) / 100
	end

	return "N/A"
end

local function showUnitStats(unit)
	selectedUnit = unit
	selectedUnitName = unit.Name

	selectedTitle.Text = unit.Name
	subtitle.Text = "EXISTING UNIT / TOWER"

	animateStat("Damage", findStat(unit, "Damage"))
	animateStat("Range", findStat(unit, "Range"))
	animateStat("Cooldown", findStat(unit, "Cooldown"))
	animateStat("Price", findStat(unit, "Price"))
	animateStat("DPS", calculateDPS(unit))

	statsScroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)

	for button, buttonUnit in pairs(towerButtons) do
		if buttonUnit == unit then
			button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(62, 100, 175)
		else
			button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 42, 53)
		end
	end
end

local function createTowerButton(unit)

	button.Name = unit.Name
	button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 42)
	button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 42, 53)

	button.Text = unit.Name

	button.TextSize = 11
	button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	button.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	button.AutoButtonColor = false
	button.Parent = towerList

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
	corner.Parent = button

	towerButtons[button] = unit

	button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		if selectedUnit ~= unit then
			TweenService:Create(
				button,
				TweenInfo.new(0.1),
				{
					BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 53, 66)
				}
			):Play()
		end
	end)

	button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		if selectedUnit ~= unit then
			TweenService:Create(
				button,
				TweenInfo.new(0.1),
				{
					BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 42, 53)
				}
			):Play()
		end
	end)

	button.Activated:Connect(function()
		showUnitStats(unit)
	end)
end

local function refreshTowers()
	for button in pairs(towerButtons) do
		if button and button.Parent then
			button:Destroy()
		end
	end

	table.clear(towerButtons)

	local objects = getAllUnitsAndTowers()

	if #objects == 0 then
		listTitle.Text = "NO TOWERS FOUND"
		return
	end

	for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
		createTowerButton(object)
	end

	listTitle.Text = "TOWERS  •  " .. tostring(#objects)

	task.defer(function()
		towerList.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	end)
end

--==================================================
-- AUTO REFRESH
--==================================================

local function isInsideUnitTowerFolder(object)
	local current = object

	while current and current ~= ReplicatedStorage do
		if isUnitTowerFolder(current) then
			return true
		end

		current = current.Parent
	end

	return false
end

ReplicatedStorage.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
	if isUnitTowerFolder(object)
		or isInsideUnitTowerFolder(object) then

		task.defer(refreshTowers)
	end
end)

ReplicatedStorage.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(object)
	if isUnitTowerFolder(object)
		or isInsideUnitTowerFolder(object) then

		task.defer(refreshTowers)
	end
end)

local function findSpawnRemote()
	local containers = {}

	local functionsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Functions")

	if functionsFolder then
		table.insert(containers, functionsFolder)
	end

	local remoteFunctions = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("RemoteFunctions")

	if remoteFunctions then
		table.insert(containers, remoteFunctions)
	end

	local remoteEvents = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("RemoteEvents")

	if remoteEvents then
		table.insert(containers, remoteEvents)
	end

	table.insert(containers, ReplicatedStorage)

	for _, container in ipairs(containers) do
		for _, wantedName in ipairs(spawnNames) do
			local remote = container:FindFirstChild(wantedName, true)

			if remote
				and (
					remote:IsA("RemoteFunction")
					or remote:IsA("RemoteEvent")
				) then

				return remote
			end
		end
	end

	return nil
end

--==================================================
-- SPAWN SELECTED
--==================================================

spawnButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	if not selectedUnitName then
		selectedTitle.Text = "SELECT A UNIT OR TOWER"
		return
	end

	local character = player.Character

	if not character then
		character = player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	end

	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not root then
		selectedTitle.Text = "CHARACTER NOT READY"
		return
	end

	local spawnRemote = findSpawnRemote()

	if not spawnRemote then
		warn("No tower/unit spawn RemoteFunction or RemoteEvent was found.")
		selectedTitle.Text = "SPAWN REMOTE NOT FOUND"
		return
	end

	local success, result = pcall(function()
		if spawnRemote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
			return spawnRemote:InvokeServer(
				selectedUnitName,
				root.CFrame
			)

		elseif spawnRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
			spawnRemote:FireServer(
				selectedUnitName,
				root.CFrame
			)

			return true
		end
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("Spawn request failed:", result)
		selectedTitle.Text = "SPAWN REQUEST FAILED"
	else
		print(
			"Spawn request sent:",
			spawnRemote:GetFullName(),
			selectedUnitName
		)
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- PC + MOBILE DRAGGING
--==================================================

local dragging = false
local dragStart = nil
local startPosition = nil
local dragInput = nil

top.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPosition = main.Position
		dragInput = input
	end
end)

top.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input == dragInput
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = false
		dragInput = nil
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if not dragging then
		return
	end

	if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		return
	end

	if not dragStart or not startPosition then
		return
	end

	local delta = input.Position - dragStart

	main.Position = UDim2.new(
		startPosition.X.Scale,
		startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
		startPosition.Y.Scale,
		startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
	)
end)
